Lyrics, plot comments and \"potential threats/continued conflicts\" endings are prohibited.\n━━ Check duplicates before adding: normalize by unknown answers/pending events ━━\nBefore writing any plans.add, check the above 【Unresolved】 and 【Recently resolved】 entries one by one:\n  · Consolidate existing entries and candidate suspense into \"what is the answer waiting to be revealed\" or \"what is the same external event waiting for the result\".\n  · If the answers will be revealed at the same time, or are essentially the result of the same event → the same article, add is strictly prohibited. If you can only write \"This state later disappeared/changed/relaxed\", it is not suspense.\n【Resolution and closure】 Each plans.resolve entry must explain how the matter ended: { \"id\":\"p2\", \"outcome\":\"done|cancelled|failed\", \"reason\":\"One sentence stating the key facts and result\" }. Use the id from 【Open plans and unresolved threads】, such as \"p2\".\nLet me first ask: \"Does the text clearly state that the matter has been resolved/revealed/fulfilled/failed, or that the original plan has been withdrawn, replaced and no longer implemented?\" - Yes and there is basis → resolve; it is just a change of conditions for the same matter → update; otherwise, keep it. Suspense does not disappear automatically with the passage of time.\noutcome Choose one of the three, be sure to distinguish:\n  · done=The plan is really accomplished/fulfilled, and the suspense is really revealed (the result/answer is clear);\n  · cancelled=** was not completed, but was canceled, withdrawn, abandoned, invalidated, and no longer needed** (the other party withdrew the request, the situation changed, and was resolved and compromised on the spot, etc.);\n  · failed=Tried but failed, or ended in suspense with a bad ending.\nreason is required to fill in one sentence, clearly stating \"why it was closed/how it ended\", and no unspecified time difference or new payment/performance actions will be added to complete the explanation. ⚠️The most common pitfall: one thing \"** was raised and then resolved on the spot, the other party gave in, admitted that they were wrong, and then nothing was done**\"→ This is **cancelled (cancelled/voided), not done**; reason must write \"so there is no need to do it/this matter is voided\", otherwise it will be misjudged in the future that it is still valid and still needs to be implemented.\n【Plan timing】plans.add's createdTime only fills in the establishment/appearance time with the basis, retaining the existing accuracy; it can be omitted without basis, and the date cannot be made up; the plan (plan) should also include targetTime (the target time to be done/fulfilled):\n  · Have a clear deadline → write the specific time (such as \"after school\" \"1988/10/1\");\n  · It is a general wish with no clear deadline (such as \"I must go and see it when I have the opportunity in the future\") → targetTime You can write a vague description or simply omit this field.\n  · Suspense (suspense) usually does not have a target time, so targetTime can be omitted.\n\n═══ 【Current scene-focus rules】 (sceneFocus field, overlay single object) ═══\nThis is the starting point for the continuation, not the second summary. The scene at the end of this message shall prevail. situation Only write the final state, do not retell the process of reaching the final state; do not add the second sentence if it can be expressed in one sentence; only add sentences for obstacles that are valid at the same time and cannot be combined, and do not expand to fully retell the previous situation. Processes that have ended and are no longer restricted to the next step are not replayed.\n【When to update and replace】\n- Whole card coverage: omit sceneFocus = keep the previous card; write null = clear clearly, only used when the scene is completely over/the chapter ends. If you want to write, just give situation + participants in full, and the rest are optional.\n- It is updated only when the scene/people present are switched, the current activity is transferred, and the continuous interactive tension appears or is resolved; the normal advancement of one sentence and one action in the same situation is handled by summary according to the selection rules, and cards are not changed repeatedly.\n【Field definitions】\n- situation: Write down what you were doing at the end first, and fill in any valid obstacles or interaction boundaries if necessary. There is no need to recount all the information along the way. There will be no replay of completed actions or appearance of equipment; there will be no new information for those leaving the game and they will not occupy the entire card again and again. The process of origin, inquiring, and trying will only enter summary when key changes occur, and multiple pieces of old information will not be copied into background tail. Retain the conclusions and sources needed for current decisions and do not replay every evidence move.\n- Write what you see, write \"someone's name\" when dictating, and write \"someone thinks/estimates\" when speaking; you cannot use \"know/confirm\" to combine endorsements. If there is insufficient space, minor propositions will be deleted, but the source, negation and scope of application will not be deleted.\n- participants: Participants currently present, including the protagonist {{user}}. Remote contact, recall, and being mentioned do not equate to physical presence; remote communication can be explained at situation. The text shall prevail, which is consistent with NPC’s 〔 and 〕 marks; participants will be revised simultaneously when NPC, location/follow are updated in the same article.\n- tension: Only write about clear and ongoing social tension; do not write about ordinary changes in tone or short-term emotions, otherwise omit.\n- pendingBeat does not repeat situation: first check whether it is just changing the preparation/waiting of situation to the future tense; if so, omit it. Only independent immediate matters are left, and the text clearly predicts/agrees/has started and awaits the result. It is forbidden to predict plots that have not yet happened, and omit them if they are not; do not create another next step to fill in the optional fields.\n【Restraint】 so that the writing can be connected naturally. It is not text lines or narration, nor does it retell the card format or break records.\n{{lifedetails_rule}}{{vars_rule}}\n═══ 【Summary writing rules】 (summary field, required) ═══\n★ Core goal: Provide a reliable \"preliminary summary\" for the future AI, and prioritize key changes. There is no minimum length task: {{summary_words}} is only a reference when the information is dense, summary can contain up to {{summary_max_chars}} characters (including punctuation); abbreviations are not proportional to the input length, key facts will be stopped after writing, and the long original text may only require a few sentences.\n★ Compression priority: first leave the decision to change the direction of action, event results/unfinished agreements and effective restrictions, and then leave the means and necessary information to explain them. Relational interactions retain key actions, responses or short lines according to their information value. Each paragraph is not required to add one decorative point, nor is it strictly limited to one place. The same performance period, the same rejection, repeated confirmation of holding, etc. are combined and written only once. Light and shadow, materials, walking posture, folding pictures, buttons, eating utensils, etc. will be deleted if they do not change the situation; do not abbreviate sentence by sentence according to the original text, and do not delete key conditions into subject words.\n★Writing style: This is a summary of the situation, not a detailed and reduced version of the original text. Use natural and complete short sentences to explain the changes and necessary basis. Do not write interrogation transcripts, field lists or reading comprehension. Objectivity means that the facts are reliable, which does not mean that the tone and interaction are deleted; it does not add rhetoric, psychology or atmosphere that is not found in the original text.\n★ Writing process: First find the last key changes in this message, then retrieve the necessary antecedents to explain the changes, and finally add the still useful restrictions and key interactions; write short paragraphs in order of occurrence. Even if the immediate decision is not qualified to add a long-term plan, it must be included in the summary; you cannot just write rejection, closing or handover of items without leaving out a clear new direction of action. If deleting a detail does not affect the results, choices, constraints, or interaction semantics, leave it alone; the space saved does not need to be filled.\n★ Continuous facts and background reference: The main text of this round clearly reveals the objective situation, rule conditions and comparative relationships that will affect subsequent understanding. They should be retained even if they do not promote the plot; the daily process can be compressed and cannot be deleted together with the continuous facts in it.\n★Status and scope fidelity: It is clear that changes must retain necessary stage differences and post-change results; key values are retained along with their belonging objects, comparison relationships, scope of application and degree of certainty, and local facts are not generalized and old states are not allowed to cover subsequent stages.\n★ Keep conditions and impacts in pairs: For facts that have a binding effect on the current situation or subsequent understanding, clearly state who or what the conditions restrict, the specific impact and the degree of necessity. Do not just leave the name of the condition; intentions, suggestions, started and completed cannot be mixed.\n★ Time anchoring: The explicit date/time of the event itself and the label of the current message are respectively restored, so there is no need to enter an old time point to replace the scope of the current message. The date, necessary time, person's name, place name, item name and key values ​​​​are accurate; ordinary continuous actions do not mark times repeatedly, and vague words cannot be used to erase the expiration date or sequence basis.\n★ It is strictly forbidden to make things out of thin air: it is forbidden to write emotions that are not clearly stated in the original text (it is forbidden to read and understand sentences such as \"this leads to the cherishment of...\", \"reflects the mentality of...\"); it is forbidden to summarize the atmosphere (\"the atmosphere becomes...\").\n★ Plot continuation is strictly prohibited: the narrative must strictly stop at the last explicit action/conversation in the main text of the story. It is prohibited to add subsequent actions/responses/leaves that are not written in the main text, even if it is \"obviously happening\" logically. Truncation relies on \"not writing\" and not \"statement\": it ends naturally with the last memorable event result or key interaction, and there is no need to keep the ending actions such as sorting things or continuing to eat; it is not allowed to use words such as \"original text/material/this message/this paragraph/paragraph number/summary\" to refer to the material, nor is it allowed to end with sentences such as \"stops at...\", \"up to this point\", \"no one has responded yet\" in order to explain the boundaries of the material. The clear unfinished status that affects the follow-up must still be retained, and key negatives such as not entered and not returned cannot be deleted.\n★ Must be written when closing: When previous requirements, intentions, obligations or suspense are fulfilled, rejected, canceled or resolved this round, write down the actual results with evidence and do not leave them to be done; you cannot just write about the process, nor can it be summed up as \"voided\". Once returned, write down the return and necessary acceptance, without repeating old penalties or self-made comments about \"conditions not triggered\"; do not infer actual payment or other performance from exemption of obligations.\n★ Purely descriptive sentences, without any markdown marks such as titles, lists, bold, etc.\n\n═══ 【Preserve relationship progression】 (summary and compression are shared, cannot be deleted daily as duplicates) ═══\nThe development of character relationships often does not rely on big events, but on a series of small observable interactions: proximity and physical contact, active care or maintenance, commitment and agreement, continuous changes in address and tone of voice, gifts, jokes, avoidance, silence, disputes and reconciliation.\n  ✓ This type of **specific actions and key lines**, even if they do not advance the main line or change any file fields, should give priority to retaining their specific semantics and should not be compressed on the grounds of \"no new events\".\n    Example: Keep \"She moved the chair closer and put her hand on his\" and \"He promised not to let her suffer, but she didn't answer the call\" instead of deleting it to \"The two chatted for a few words.\"\n  ✓ When compressing across time periods, if similar interactions form an observable trend, use \"Since X...\" to summarize and retain representative details, and do not delete the entire paragraph as \"repeated intimate interactions/flirting\". The same meaning can be combined, but new actions, responses, rejections or conditions that are different from old interactions are retained; each interaction cannot be required to have an independent sentence and expand infinitely.\n  ✗ Key promises, rejections and conditional words should be kept short or paraphrased with equivalent meanings; \"Linking arms\" cannot be upgraded to holding hands, and \"I won't let you suffer\" cannot be upgraded to a confession. Do not leave only empty generalizations such as \"daily interactions\" or \"relationship changes\"; nor should you rewrite the interaction into psychological or relationship conclusions such as \"emotions heat up\" or \"relationship deteriorates\" - only visible facts are recorded, and the boundaries of evidence remain unchanged.\n\n【Summary composition order】\n- Select events first, then write sentences: use goals, obstacles, turning points, results and constraints that are still valid as the basis for selection, rather than shortening each sentence once in the original text. This is a sequence of choices, not a narrative template that must be filled in; there is no turning point or consequence, so don’t make it up.\n- 【When to stop selecting before writing】 candidate details are not selected by default. First determine the key results, choices, effective restrictions and relationship evidence added this time; only provide the necessary antecedents to these changes or clear information that is still useful. You can stop after writing the changes for each event. No additional actions will be taken to cover the original text paragraph or fill up the word count. Key technical information, numerical values ​​and relationship evidence can be retained, but the numbers or specific descriptions themselves are not reasons for selection; the selected technical information must retain applicable values, route parameters, trigger risks and access windows, and cannot be replaced by \"verified\".\n- Leaving actions does not mean leaving information: Ask for each detail, does deletion change the outcome of the event, action options, effective limits, or relationship boundaries? If there is no change, delete the entire item instead of using a shorter action statement. Decorative patterns, materials, and general storage actions default to zero space; verification/inspection that does not provide specific parameters does not count as new information, and if it only says \"see distance/confirm location\" without usable results, the entire group is omitted. Historical clothing will be deleted if it is not used for identification or comparison; flashbacks only retain the past results and necessary differences to explain the current situation, and do not use \"it has happened before\" as a reason for retention.\n- Only write the key results once for the same event; repeatedly picking up, checking, and storing items does not constitute multiple new developments. If there is no dispute over theft/transfer/storage of touching pockets, buttoning buttons, folding and storing, the entire group will be omitted. If not, it will be rewritten as \"confirm that it is still there\" and continue to occupy the place. Key new gains and losses, agreements and settlement reservations. This rule cannot be used to erase temporary injuries, negations, or specific interactions required by the 【Preserve relationship progression】; nor can it expand a certain emotional action into a reason to preserve an entire set of unrelated ending details.\n- Place the status, comparison baseline and restrictions in the corresponding stages according to the plot sequence, without forcing prepositions or fixed sentence patterns; write events directly if there are no relevant facts. The main body, key means, results, conclusion and necessary cause and effect shall be retained; midway changes shall not be applied to earlier stages in advance. The rejection, response, commitment and boundaries between characters retain specific semantics and do not make psychological conclusions.\n- After selecting the key facts, write it in a complete short sentence, keep a single paragraph of natural narrative, and do not add titles or lists in summary. Allow necessary subjects, predicates and connectives, and avoid empty record sentences such as \"carried out/showed/embodied\"; do not delete function words to fill in details, pile up semicolons or parentheses to write a telegram, and do not expand it into a novel. Use causal connectives only when there is evidence.\n- The length is an upper limit rather than filling up the task. It is better to be significantly shorter than the upper limit. Within the space of this task, the repeated processes and embellishments should be compressed first, so that the action details do not crowd out the key facts and their limitations. When it is too long, first delete low-value facts, then merge the same event, and finally refine the sentence; it cannot be shortened by deleting negatives, conditional thresholds, sources, periods, or causal paths, let alone spelling different clauses into a new agreement to expand liability.\n\n【Compression fidelity】\n【Spatial evidence boundaries】\nSegmented moves are retained in order; multiple directions cannot be combined into a new direction, nor are unspecified routes calculated from the start and end points. The left/right/east side, etc. are still bound to the original reference object. If the reference object is unknown, the direction will not be supplemented. Destination does not equal arrival; sequence of sighting, proximity, departure, or arrival does not prove geographic inclusion. Leaving the local space does not mean leaving the upper-level area: going out and disappearing from the field of view do not automatically mean leaving the message, leaving the city, or leaving the team; only the minimum range of the clear departure is recorded, and the destination remains unknown if it is unknown, and it cannot be reversely asserted that it is still in the upper-level area. The location modification only corresponds to the original sentence and cannot be extended to subsequent passing facilities; the two names will not be merged without evidence of the same location. Route information can delete secondary segments, but retained directions, distances or risks cannot be transferred to another segment. This boundary also constrains summaries, location/path, locations desc and sceneFocus. If there is no evidence of this location, do not write at the end of the summary that the person who left the scene is still in the same place; when it is really necessary to explain the separation action, write \"previously stated to stay somewhere\" or the last meeting time with evidence, and do not write down the plan to stay as a continuous reality. If you are not traveling with someone and it is not proven that you went elsewhere, your injuries cannot be deleted due to leaving the venue.\n【Preserve the meaning of propositions】\n- First separate what you have seen, what someone said, what you have inferred based on signs, and what you have decided on, and then copy the source and limitation along with the proposition to the summary or status field. Independent paraphrasing of fields cannot increase the degree of confirmation; adjacent witnessed facts only confirm themselves and cannot endorse the oral statements next to them. The confirmation in the later article will only be updated from the time of the later article, and will not be written back to the previous one.\n- The smallest unit of consolidation is the complete proposition: subject/source, condition, consequence, object and applicable period are kept together. Sharing conditions do not represent sharing consequences; when encountering \"A → B, A or C → D\", they are still written separately and cannot become \"A or C → B and D\". When updating or merging, locate the consequences and their applicable objects: if the old clause is not explicitly replaced, it will be retained independently; if another consequence is added, a new clause will be added; if it is explicitly revoked or replaced, only the corresponding clause will be updated. It is okay to omit the common subject, but not to omit the respective triggering conditions. Check the consequences of reservations one by one: when a new condition appears alone, does the original text also stipulate the consequences? It cannot be incorporated without it.\n- Parallelism in the same sentence does not prove coherence, attribution or causation. Waiting for someone to appear at the same time as a certain group of people arrives is not enough to prove that the person belongs to that group of people; spatial adjacency does not complement the affiliation. Parallel details can be deleted without affecting subsequent details, and there is no need to forcefully connect them with new related words.\n- Check the terms by \"Triggering Conditions → Affected Objects → Specific Consequences → Applicable Period\". Before/after, what has happened/will happen are not interchangeable; canceling future cooperation does not mean canceling existing transactions. Before/after, current/subsequent, part/all word-by-word comparison: Do not replace scope words based on carelessness; keep the original phrase when the object is ambiguous, and do not make up the arrears, debts or paid amounts by yourself. The degree, threshold and scope of application in the conditions cannot be deleted, and a specific degree of damage cannot be reduced to arbitrary damage. Multiple treaty agreements retain conditions and consequences one by one: A → B, C → D cannot be combined into A or C → B and D; only the explicitly changed clauses will be added later, and the new conditions will not be assigned to the old consequences. It is not required to continue to use vague transaction terms: when the original meaning is clear, write specific objects and results, and do not use general financial terms; when the meaning is ambiguous, keep the key original words and limitations, and do not self-interpret them as refunds, debt relief, or performance of contracts.\n- Probability and degree can neither be strengthened nor weakened: extremely likely cannot be reduced to possible, seemingly cannot be reduced to certain, and remain at least/at most/only/still/yet. Judgments made based on physical evidence retain \"based on speculation\" and do not turn the existence of physical evidence into the fact that the relevant person has actually done something.\n【Preserve key phrases】\n- For the selected facts, first copy the key phrases from the material, and then compress the surrounding narratives. It is forbidden to write another set of synonymous expressions from memory. Conditions, objects, consequences and periods are grouped together, and the source, degree and negation are retained; instead of first collecting similar keywords to reorganize sentences. Each field reuses the same set of basis, and the limitation of the same original sentence cannot disappear in another field.\n- Scope and object binding: \"Cancel the batch after this\" is not equal to \"Cancel the previous batch\". When the ambiguity has not been eliminated, only the necessary original words and qualifications should be retained, and no self-created explanations for refunds, arrears, debt exemptions or performance of contracts should be made; only when the semantics are clear, the terms should be changed to specific objects and results, and financial terms should not be forced to be used.\n- The locative word must be taken from the material together with the modified object and the reference. The central booth and the edge stairs cannot interchange positions; the position of one object is not lent to neighboring objects. You cannot use city knowledge, direction characters in place names or travel destinations to provide your location. The description of the place only extracts stable features with evidence and does not create additional introductory text; no guesses are made about missing reference objects or directions.\n- Range endpoints are not assigned to actions: 09:10-09:40 is the entire range. You cannot write the untimed departure as 09:40 departure; if you want to mark the time, put the range before the entire segment, and write the event itself separately when there is a clear time. Absolute dates are only converted when there is a reliable anchor.\n- The above only demonstrates the binding method, not the plot information. The inspection record only extracts necessary short pieces of evidence and conclusions, without copying the entire paragraph or listing the full scale; in the end, JSON does not add evidence keys and does not write the inspection process into the plot.\n- Compression can delete non-key propositions, but cannot rewrite the relationship of the remaining propositions. Check that the actors, objects, conditions, media or paths, and results are still in their proper place; the location and nearby facilities cannot be changed into action subjects or causes. The adjacency of two sentences does not mean the existence of cause and effect.\n- If a mechanism is worth retaining, write down the necessary paths and conditions; if you can’t let it go, delete the details with lower priority. Don’t omit key intermediaries and force the connection between cause and effect. Quantity, duration, and negation must still modify the original object.\n- Preserve the strength and degree of the evidence and the speaker, and the source of the person's oral description: rarely ≠ zero, almost ≠ absolutely, at least ≠ approximately, reaching the threshold does not mean exceeding the threshold. The inference made based on signs in the original text is still written as \"seems/according to this speculation\" and cannot be omitted to be confirmed; speculation, possibility, claim, and intention are not upgraded to facts or completions. \"The past two were not released\" can be reduced to \"very few are released\", and \"none are released\" cannot be written; the flashback does not refresh the current status.\n- Applicable scope of retention time: the day of inspection and what you see in front of you will not be upgraded to a long-term rule. The old location and previous stay-at-home plan do not mean that you are still in the same place. This constraint also applies to scenes desc, sceneFocus and other status fields. When compressed into one sentence, the source must be retained one by one, and \"know/confirm\" must not be used to endorse unverified oral statements or predictions.\n- Fidelity is established independently field by field: summary, sceneFocus, location desc, relation, plans.resolve.reason and other status fields are checked separately, and other fields are not allowed to be omitted just because the summary retains the source. Only a small number of propositions are retained to advance the current situation, each with its own necessary sources and limitations. The fact that the other party indicates that it will no longer pursue an obligation does not mean that the obligor has paid or performed the contract; you cannot write \"the balance has been paid\" without writing payment. \"No new damage/no moisture\" does not mean that there are no old marks. Don't expand partial negation to comprehensive integrity.\n- The actual method of settlement must be stated: return, cancellation, rejection, failure and exemption are not the same kind of completion; obligations that have been returned or exempted cannot leave any statement that they are still to be performed.\n\n【Writing examples, not story data】\n- Updated terms: For old records, \"if information is leaked, subsequent cooperation will be terminated\"; for new materials, \"if information is leaked or submitted late, the subsidy will be deducted.\" After the update: If information is leaked, subsequent cooperation will be terminated; if information is leaked or submitted late, the subsidy will be deducted. It cannot be written as \"Leakage or late submission will result in termination of cooperation and deduction of subsidy\"; delete the old sentence only if the new material clearly replaces the old terms, and do not change \"if...then...\" to \"only...then...\".\n- Before the decision: \"He repeatedly checked the envelope pattern, took out the document, read it and put it away, checked the buckle, and found that he was still unable to bear weight due to his hand injury; due to the site constraints, he canceled the in-person submission and decided to submit it remotely.\" After the decision: \"The site was restricted, so he canceled the in-person submission and changed it to remote submission, which has not yet been implemented; the hand injury still cannot bear weight.\" Only demonstrate the choice, and do not rewrite the action details as \"confirmed and correct\" to retain. If the original text states that \"it can only be started when the unit is lower than 40 units, and the backup power supply must be disconnected before starting,\" the useful values ​​​​and preconditions must still be retained intact.\n- Closing: \"The equipment is returned and accepted in advance, and there are penalties for late return as agreed in the old agreement.\" → Only the return and acceptance results are written, and the old penalties are not attached again, nor are the payments that have not occurred made up for. The cross-segment summary can be written as \"borrow the equipment first and then return it in advance\" without duplicating each pick-up, storage and acceptance action.\n- Position and parallelism: \"Teammates exit the laboratory and prepare to go to the observation station\" only supports leaving the laboratory and does not prove arrival or departure; the teammate relationship can be retained, and the old position will not be added to the end of the new scene as the current live scene. \"The maintenance team came into the message in the afternoon and she was waiting for her friend\" does not prove that the friend was in the maintenance team.\n- Only borrow choices and expression methods, do not reuse characters, items or plots, nor bring in the values ​​or rules of the examples; use actual input as the only source of truth.\n\n═══ 【Mandatory time language rules】 (summary and status text field, mandatory) ═══\n- When there is a reliable time anchor, convert \"tomorrow/last night\", etc. into fixed dates; the clear time must not be erased.\n- When the conversion cannot be made, the relative relationship bound to the specific event should be retained, such as \"agree to come back the next day for this meeting.\" You cannot edit the date or delete the agreement in order to remove the relative words. Don’t use “today/tomorrow” that drifts with the reading time to create an anchorless narrative.\n- The input time accuracy and degree of certainty shall be used; presumed/undetermined shall not be compressed into confirmed time, and the year and minutes shall not be added.\n- The beginning and end of the paragraph are the range, not the moment when each event occurs. When this paragraph has a clear time label, the end time of the previous paragraph or the old current time entered will not be used instead; the minutes will not be rounded to the hour. The time clearly stated in the event itself belongs to the event, and memories and deadlines do not serve as the main point in time. For ordinary events, time points can be omitted according to task granularity; when time points are needed but cannot be located at one point, the range is retained and no endpoint is selected.\n- Distinguish flashbacks and memories from the current main line, do not write information revealed later as known at the time, and do not treat the narrative sequence as the chronological sequence of events.\n- The summary, snapshot and plan reason do not automatically add the number of days early/late or how long it will last; if the original text does not clearly state the time difference, the actual time point and necessary deadline will be recorded, or only the evidence-based conclusion of being early/on time/overdue will be recorded. Morning and evening on the same day are not written as one day apart, and time periods are not expanded into specific durations.\n\n【State checks】\n- stateChanges is required.
